reviewer: Kimi actual visual comparison of exact native source, enlarged source page, complete unchanged native RGBA, full white/cyan/alpha sheet and unchanged mascot reference

entries.positive_observation: Dark navy peaked cap with gold front insignia and gold visor decoration, graying temple hair and pale eyebrows are retained. The face has no moustache or beard and shows the source's friendly slightly open smile rather than a neutral replacement mouth. Dark navy uniform, prominent viewer-left gold shoulder board, white shirt, dark tie and small pale collar decorations remain. The rounded chin meets a short broad fitted collar without a stalk, clipping or cream bib. The complete tilted frame, muted photographic backing, overlapping note with compact upper marks and mostly blank lower paper, and right-edge tab are retained. Full white/cyan comparisons show no interior holes, missing opaque backing or working-matte halo.
entries.alpha_decision: Accept native RGBA with a genuine transparent exterior outside the complete card/note silhouette. Near-opacity values252..254 do not by themselves reject the image; actual white/cyan inspection found no visible interior holes. No source-alpha replacement was performed or needed.
entries.visible_limitations: The exact cap/collar insignia shapes are too small to transcribe at 65x67; visible metallic colors, placement and counts were checked without inventing exact symbols or claiming microscopic identity. Note marks remain indistinct source-scale groups rather than newly readable text.
entries.canonical_write_boundary: Art approval and byte-identical generated_fullsize archival are complete. No concurrent generated.json write was attempted while the separate built-in owner is active.
